name: Hidamari no Sanatorium
original_name: ひだまりのサナトリウム
source:
Miyuu, a boy with a frail constitution, meets Sumire, a leukemic recently hospitalized due to his high fever. Feeling for Sumire, Miyuu gradually finds himself attracted to the other boy.
